# ADR Template

Store completed ADRs in `docs/adr/`. Copy the structure below.

```markdown
# ADR-XXX: Title

## Status

Proposed / Accepted / Deprecated / Superseded

## Date

YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

<!-- Describe the problem. -->

## Options Considered

### Option 1

**Advantages**

- ...

**Disadvantages**

- ...

### Option 2

**Advantages**

- ...

**Disadvantages**

- ...

## Decision

<!-- Describe the selected option. -->

## Consequences

### Positive

- ...

### Negative

- ...

## Related Services

- [Service]

## Related Documentation

- [Documentation Link]
```
